maddeler.e:
اعتكدوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَكَدُوا (iʕtakadū) /iʕ.ta.ka.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اُعْتُكِدُوا (uʕtukidū) /uʕ.tu.ki.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# اِعْتَكِدُوا (iʕtakidū) /iʕ.ta.ki.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
